summary: Iteration 80: Push notifications system and Programs page redesign testing. Backend: 7/7 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements and data-testid attributes working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified. Push notification system: geofence_alerts preference exists in GET /api/push/preferences (true by default), PUT accepts geofence_alerts field, geofence check calls notify_geofence_exit to guardians. Programs: GET /api/programs/catalog returns 10+ programs with all required fields (id, title, subtitle, icon, color, category, duration_days, phases, benefits), GET /api/programs/detail/{id} returns full detail. Frontend: Programs page completely redesigned with BG_IMAGES.beneficiary background, category filter chips with icons, program cards with hover animations. Program Detail page has 4-step flow (presentation, onboarding, invite, start), hero with icon/title, phases list, benefits, CTA buttons.
